reading.title: Asking about medicine forms
reading.text: Omar takes his prescription to the pharmacist. He asks whether the medicine comes as a tablet or a capsule. The pharmacist checks the prescription before answering. Omar also asks what cream and ointment mean. He does not choose a medicine from its color or shape. Before leaving, he asks the pharmacist to explain any instruction he does not understand.
